name: Vaseline Gluta Hya Flawless Glow Serum in Lotion 200ml | India
description:
Product details of Vaseline Gluta Hya Flawless Glow Serum in Lotion – 200ml (India)

Product Type: Body Lotion / Flawless Glow Serum

Size: 200ml

Origin: India

Key Features:

GlutaGlow Technology: 10× more powerful than Vitamin C, helps reduce dullness and brightens skin

Hyaluron: Boosts skin’s moisture for a dewy, hydrated feel

Pro-Retinol: Helps exfoliate dead skin cells for a smoother, even-toned complexion

Dual UV Filters: Protects skin from harmful sun exposure

Vaseline Jelly: Locks in moisture deep within the skin for long-lasting hydration

Suitable for daily use to achieve glowy, nourished, and healthy-looking skin
